coding_attempt.scope: Frontend catalog layout, filters, and model-detail navigation
coding_attempt.applied_patch: An approved HomeView.vue update added URL-synchronized catalog filters and improved the narrower-screen filter layout.
coding_attempt.outcome: The run later stopped on provider HTTP 400. The persisted safe diagnostic showed type invalid_request_error, with no code or parameter. A final agent response was not completed.

isolated_checks.read_file_tool_cycle: A fresh Claude conversation read model-zoo/README.md through one read_file call and completed with a one-sentence project summary.

frontend_build.execution: xMind native process tool via its trusted PowerShell profile

follow_up_coding_attempt.scope: Restore removable active-filter controls in HomeView.vue
follow_up_coding_attempt.result: Approved single-file update restored keyboard-accessible active-filter buttons and Clear all control; no other file was edited.
follow_up_coding_attempt.run_completion: The file update and build succeeded, but xMind recorded a provider HTTP 400 (invalid_request_error) before a final agent response. No safe code or parameter was returned; the cause is still unknown.

saved_history_recovery.action: After the failed run, sent a no-tools follow-up asking for a concise summary of its persisted results.
saved_history_recovery.outcome: The run completed and accurately reported the restored filter controls, npm build exit code 0, Vite 6.4.4, 36 transformed modules and 583 ms build. No additional file or process tools were invoked.
saved_history_recovery.implication: A new turn recovered the final response from saved tool history; this does not identify the cause of the preceding HTTP 400 or prove automatic recovery.

limitations: Both original multi-step coding runs ended on provider HTTP 400 before a final response. Their authorized edits were applied, the follow-up build exited 0, and a separate subsequent turn recovered a final summary from persisted results. The safe diagnostic does not identify the 400 cause or establish automatic recovery.
The earlier selected DeepSeek conversation was cancelled after growing to about 64,000 input tokens and many tool turns; it was not used for these clean-session checks.
The page was visually and interactively checked in the Codex in-app browser; Microsoft Edge and mobile viewport checks remain open.
Backend route availability was checked over HTTP, but separate API contract or failure-path tests were not run.
